rubrics.name: tool_call_integrity

rubrics.name: statute_coverage
rubrics.evidence: Section 3306(c)(2) at line 325 was retrieved via sed -n '251,350p' which covered the full provision needed.

rubrics.name: grounded_reasoning
rubrics.evidence: The $3,200 wage figure comes from the case facts and the $1,000 threshold comes from Section 3306(c)(2) line 325.

rubrics.name: provision_selection
rubrics.evidence: The solver correctly identified that Section 3306(c)(2) defines employment with an exception for domestic service unless $1,000+ is paid, and Alice's $3,200 exceeds this threshold.

rubrics.name: tool_assisted_computation
rubrics.evidence: No arithmetic computation was required; the task involved a simple threshold comparison ($3,200 vs $1,000) which is a yes/no entailment check.
